description: T-4506: a refreshOnLoad pivot whose cache source is the defined name IndexSrc = Data!$A$1:INDEX(Data!$B:$B,COUNTA(Data!$A:$A)), a sheet-qualified corner joined to INDEX by `:`, the common dynamic-range idiom. Data!A1:B6 is Region/Sales with East =1000 (cached as missing by the case builder), West 20, East 5, North 7, South 3; the saved cache is built from Data!A1:B4 only, so a render from the cache shows East 5, West 20, total 25 and a refresh through the name East 1005, West 20, North 7, South 3, total 1035. Q reads the pivot's A3:B9 and ROWS(IndexSrc). Kept apart from t4506-pivot-named-sources because the engine does not parse the body yet.
